objects.description: One sitting of the council or one of its committees: what it is called, the day it is held, where, and which committee holds it. Agendas, minutes and resolutions hang off a meeting.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: instance_id
fields.description: The agency the meeting belongs to. Every read is narrowed to one of these, so one agency never reads another's meetings.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What the meeting is called, such as "Budget session".

fields.name: date
fields.description: The day it is held, as YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: place
fields.description: Where it is held, in plain words. Empty when not yet fixed.

fields.name: committee
fields.description: The committee that holds it, as the committee group's name or id. Empty for a sitting of the whole council.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the meeting was put on record, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

indexes.name: instance_date
indexes.description: Listing one agency's meetings by day.

objects.description: The items a meeting will take up, in order. One agenda per meeting; setting it again replaces the items.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: instance_id
fields.description: The agency the agenda belongs to. Every read is narrowed to one of these, so one agency never reads another's agenda.

fields.name: meeting_id
fields.description: The meeting the agenda is for.

fields.name: items
fields.description: The items in the order they are taken, as a list of non-blank text lines.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the agenda was first set, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the items were last set, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

indexes.name: instance_meeting
indexes.description: One agenda per meeting of one agency.

objects.description: The written record of what a meeting did. One text per meeting; setting it again replaces the text.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: instance_id
fields.description: The agency the minutes belong to. Every read is narrowed to one of these, so one agency never reads another's minutes.

fields.name: meeting_id
fields.description: The meeting the minutes are for.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The minutes, as plain text.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the minutes were first set, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the text was last set, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

indexes.name: instance_meeting
indexes.description: One set of minutes per meeting of one agency.

objects.description: A decision the council took: what it was, the day it was taken and how it came out. It may name the meeting it was taken at.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: instance_id
fields.description: The agency the resolution belongs to. Every read is narrowed to one of these, so one agency never reads another's resolutions.

fields.name: meeting_id
fields.description: The meeting it was taken at. Empty for a resolution not tied to a meeting on record.

fields.name: title
fields.description: What was decided, in a line, such as "Adopt the 2027 budget".

fields.name: date
fields.description: The day it was taken, as YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: How the vote came out.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the resolution was put on record, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

indexes.name: instance_date
indexes.description: Listing one agency's resolutions by day.

indexes.name: instance_meeting
indexes.description: Listing the resolutions taken at one meeting.
